grammar_focus: 方向 / 位置介词短语(回答 Where / Which direction:to/from、into/out of、for、towards、at,KS9 扩展)主考 + on + 动名词(= as soon as '一…就…')/ that 引导定语从句(可省略)辅考·课文①类
scene: 几乎过了一个星期,那姑娘才能讲述自己的遭遇。一天下午,她乘小船从海岸出发,遇上了暴风雨;天将黑时小船撞上一块礁石,姑娘跳进海里,在水里泡了整整一夜才游到岸边——那段时间她游了8英里。第二天凌晨,她看到前方有灯光,知道自己已接近岸边(灯光高悬在峭壁上)。一到岸边,她就朝灯光挣扎着爬上峭壁。她记得的就是这些。第二天醒来,她发现自己躺在医院里。

grammar_card.title: 方向与位置的介词短语
grammar_card.intro: 回答 Where / Which direction 的问题,常用介词短语:to / from(去向/来源)、into / out of(进入/出来)、for(前往)、towards(朝…方向)、at(对着一点)。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: to / from → 去向 / 来源
He flew to Washington from Chicago.
into / out of → 进入 / 出来
She jumped into the sea. / out of the window.
We set out for the village.
The boy threw a stone at a dog.

specialRules.rule: on + 动名词 = as soon as 引导的时间状语,'一…就…':On arriving at the shore, she struggled up.
that 引导定语从句修饰前面的名词,作宾语时常省略:That was all (that) she remembered.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why was the girl in the hospital?
options: She was caught in a storm at sea and swam to shore, exhausted
She had fallen off a cliff

passage: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her. One afternoon she set out from the coast in a small boat and was caught in a storm. Toward evening, the boat struck a rock and the girl jumped into the sea. Then she swam to shore after spending the whole night in the water. During that time she covered a distance of eight miles. Early next morning, she saw a light ahead. She knew she was near the shore because the light was high up on the cliffs. On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff toward the light she had seen. That was all she remembered. When she woke up a day later, she found herself in the hospital.

grammar_points.name: to / from 短语(去向 / 来源)
into / out of 短语(进入 / 出来)

stage5.stem: "He flew ___ Washington last night."(表示去往某地)
"She set out ___ the coast in a small boat."(表示从某处出发)
"He will be flying from Washington ___ Chicago."(from … 搭配,表示到某地)
stage5.stem_cn: 他将从华盛顿飞往芝加哥。

stage5.stem: "The girl jumped ___ the sea."(表示跳进…里面)
"I threw the paper ___ the window."(表示扔到…外面)
"We set out ___ the village at six o'clock."(表示前往某地)
"George has left ___ Scotland."(表示动身去某地)
"The boy threw a stone ___ a dog."(表示对着一个目标点)
"It is rude to point ___ people."(表示对着某人)
"Where did he go? He went ___ the cinema."(回答'去哪儿',表示去往)
stage5.stem_cn: 他去哪儿了?他去了电影院。

stage5.stem: "Where is Carol? She has just gone ___ the kitchen."(回答'在哪儿',表示进入)
stage5.stem_cn: 卡罗尔在哪儿?她刚进厨房去了。

stage5.stem: "Which direction did she swim? She swam ___ the shore."(回答'朝哪个方向')
stage5.stem_cn: 她朝哪个方向游?她朝岸边游去。

stage5.stem: "___ arriving at the shore, she struggled up the cliff."(一到岸边就…,后接动名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一到岸边,她就挣扎着爬上峭壁。

stage5.stem: "On ___ home, he called his mother at once."(一…就…,介词后接动名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一到家,他就给母亲打了电话。

stage5.stem: "That was all ___ she remembered."(引导定语从句修饰 all,可省略)
"She climbed toward the light ___ she had seen."(引导定语从句修饰 the light)
stage5.stem_cn: 她朝她看到的那盏灯爬去。
